messages:
maria_customer: Hey team — woke up to our monthly invoice and it's ~18% higher than dashboard estimates. Invoice ID INV-2026-2119, month Feb. Dashboard shows ~1.2M tokens, invoice lists 1.42M. No product changes on our end. Can someone help triage?

emma_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste a short reproducible request (curl or SDK) that shows the client-side token estimate vs what you think was billed?

maria_customer: yes. We used the Python SDK. Simplified repro below (we're using streaming in prod):
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
rc = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = rc.chat.create(model="open-rw-3", messages=[{"role":"system","content":"You are concise."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following..."}], streaming=True)
# client estimator: resp.metadata.token_estimate = 420
# we aggregated per-request estimates across sessions and got ~1.2M tokens for month
```

jamal_billing: @maria_customer can you share a single request id or timestamp from the invoice window? we can look up server-side metering for that session.

maria_customer: sure — one example: request_id=rq_8f3c2a, created_at=2026-02-14T09:22:31Z. Dashboard row shows estimate 415 tokens; invoice raw line item shows 612 tokens for that call.

emma_support: thanks. pinging @metering-bot to pull raw meter logs for rq_8f3c2a. :eyes:

metering-bot: Automated log lookup: found events for rq_8f3c2a -> server_count=612 tokens, breakdown: prompt=198, completion=414. Additional server-side metadata: system_preamble_tokens=44, tool_injection_tokens=0. (link to internal trace).

alex_dev: quick hypothesis: the SDK estimator currently counts only user + assistant tokens as returned in the final payload and omits server-inserted system preamble tokens added during runtime (we recently rolled a change to add a short runtime system preamble to every streaming session for routing/compat). That would explain ~44 extra tokens per call.

maria_customer: interesting — but 44 * ~10k calls = 440k tokens, which still doesn't cover the full 220k delta for the month. Anything else could inflate counts?

jamal_billing: also check for reconnects/stream resumes — repeated partial completions can double-count on server meter but client estimator may dedupe. Any streaming reconnect logs?

maria_customer: we do see occasional reconnects around 02/14 and 02/28. Example log snippet: "session_resume: rq_8f3c2a-part1 resumed at 09:22:35, resumed_chunks=3"

emma_support: that fits. Metering logs treat resumed chunks as separate token events. The SDK estimator tries to coalesce on client side but only if the session id matches exactly; if the server emits new request ids on resume they won't be merged.

alex_dev: to reproduce locally, try curl to our /v1/chat/completions endpoint with explicit system preamble insertion by server (we can emulate). Example curl we used to repro:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-rw-3","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"[runtime-preamble]"},{"role":"system","content":"You are concise."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize X"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions
```
This yields server_count = client_estimate + server_preamble. Also enable simulated reconnects to see double counts.

jamal_billing: actionable items: 1) we'll run a full invoice window audit for INV-2026-2119 and produce a CSV of all server_count vs dashboard estimate per request id; 2) product/SDK to add a note in estimator docs about server-inserted tokens and how to opt-out; 3) if audit shows >5% unexplained variance we will propose a one-time credit pending findings.

maria_customer: thanks — really appreciate the transparency. For next steps, can we get the CSV and a short explanation of how to detect reconnect double-counts on our side?

emma_support: yep. @jamal_billing please attach CSV and include filter keys: request_id, created_at, client_estimate, server_count, server_preamble_tokens, resumed_flag.

jamal_billing: will do. I scheduled the audit job and expect results in ~48 hours. If we confirm server_preamble + resumptions explain the delta we'll also include a recommended SDK fix (coalescing resumed chunks by parent_session metadata).

maria_customer: ok thanks. One more Q: is there a current SDK flag to disable runtime preamble insertion so we can test billing parity?

alex_dev: not in stable release yet — we have an internal env var REDWOOD_DISABLE_RUNTIME_PREAMBLE for testing. I'll open an SDK GH issue with repro and link it here.

maria_customer: great, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

emma_support: marking as escalated to billing audit (case #SUP-1742). We'll follow up in-thread with CSV and proposed credits.

jamal_billing: CSV uploaded to secure bucket and shared with @maria_customer. Audit summary: unexplained delta reduced to 2.1% after accounting for preamble + resumed chunks; issuing a pro-rated credit of $214. Details in the CSV.

maria_customer: received and confirmed. Credit looks right. Please keep us posted about SDK change and a doc note so we can adjust our estimator.

emma_support: will loop in docs and SDK owners. Closing loop for now but leave thread for follow-ups. Thanks all.
